purpose: Compare exact exported cross-fitted physical predictions with the pre-existing physical JSON per-query dimensional RMSE and source-group/fold receipts.
readout_reconstruction: Each fold ridge readout was reconstructed from cached true-target latents using the original fixed settings below because the source physical JSON contains aggregate metrics, not prediction arrays or saved coefficients. No hyperparameter was selected from held-out errors; all exported metrics and fold/source-group receipts are compared to the source JSON.

protocol.candidate_bank_rule: frozen goal-directed revision (timed-arrival): 11 unit-vector amplitudes 0..1 toward the 32px goal plus deadline controls gap/(h*speed) for h in {5,10,15,20,25} raw steps and every registered speed, deduplicated at 7 decimals; the identical union is repeated for five blocks under every speed condition.

cost_metric.definition: Euclidean distance in pixels between the controlled-agent position at each block end and goal_state
cost_metric.extras: first_entry_block, min_distance_px; task-specific indicators in aux_* arrays

protocol.coverage_round: all registered Development source queries; five endpoints 5,10,15,20,25 physical steps
protocol.filtering: none: no scene removed for scores, reachability, dynamics separability or replay failure
protocol.goal_rule: 32 pixels toward original goal; unchanged from previous timed-arrival panel
protocol.replay_rule: no reset at query: the real source prefix is replayed in the pinned simulator for every candidate; queue/state carried over
protocol.scene_selection: ALL 300 registered unseen-interpolation Development queries (seeds 42-47 x 50) in frozen (eval_seed, evaluation_index) order; no extrapolation tracks this round; none filtered
